Subject: Helix Health MAP: executive summary & close cadence for deployment mode + region

Emma — following up from our workshop last week. Attached is a concise MAP (Helix_MAP_v1.docx) that captures the milestones we discussed and three recommended deployment lanes (hosted / dedicated / private) with estimated timelines and acceptance gates.

High-level ask: can you confirm by EOD next Tuesday which deployment lane you prefer for MVP launch (hosted, dedicated, or private)? That choice drives the procurement path and the earliest go-live date.

Summary highlights inside the doc:
- Hosted: fastest time-to-value (2–4 weeks), lower operational overhead, multi-tenant, US regional tenancy available
- Dedicated: predictable throughput & capacity isolation (6–8 weeks; procurement + reserved capacity)
- Private: VPC/on-prem for PHI-sensitive workloads (10–14 weeks; network & legal integration)

Immediate next steps I propose:
1) Helix picks lane by 2026-08-10
2) Redwood drafts SOW + security attachments for chosen lane by 2026-08-12
3) Joint acceptance/gate review by 2026-08-20 (engineering + security)

If helpful, we can run a 30-min call Monday to walk through the tradeoffs with Karthik and Irene.

Thanks — Jonas

Emma — thanks for the context. Two quick clarifying points on Dedicated vs Private:

- Dedicated: provides a single-tenant GPU pool and you can pin region (we have US-east and US-west clusters). We can provide SOC 2 Type II report extract and a signed BAA for PHI. Logs and metrics can be exported to your SIEM in-region; retention window is configurable. Typical ramp: 6–8 weeks (procurement + provisioning + network setup).

- Private: if you require on-prem we’ll run through our Private deployment checklist (network handoff, KMS/HSM integration, air-gap options). Expect 10–14 weeks primarily driven by network and legal signoffs.

If your InfoSec wants to start with a gap analysis, Irene can share a one-page security summary and a short questionnaire we typically use with healthcare customers. We can plan to have procurement paperwork (SOW + pricing) ready within 48 hours after you confirm lane.

I’ve tentatively scheduled a 30-min sync for Tue 2026-08-04 10:00 AM PT — please confirm or propose another time.

Thanks — Karthik
